sources.description: Small advisor-card cutout: a narrow dark grey photograph frame tilted slightly counterclockwise, with a complete opaque dark blue-grey photographic backing, and a pale yellow-beige note overlapping the right side and lower-right portrait. The note is tilted slightly clockwise, has two short blurred grey-brown mark rows near its top, a largely blank lower area and uneven right/lower paper edges. Keep transparency only outside the combined photograph-frame-and-note silhouette; do not remove the dark opaque photograph backing or dark suit. A chest-up man faces and looks toward screen-left in a slight three-quarter view, with a serious furrowed brow and closed, slightly pursed lips. He has short dark brown/black hair swept back from a left-of-centre part with lighter grey temples, dark eyebrows, and a clearly visible dark horizontal moustache above the lips; no separate chin beard is visible. No hat or eyewear is visibly present. He wears a near-black formal suit with lapels, a white shirt collar and a dark reddish-brown necktie. The note obscures much of the screen-right shoulder and lower chest. Light catches the forehead, nose, cheek and white collar, while the far side of the face, suit and blue-grey photo backing remain dark. Preserve this close crop, directional face lighting, stern gaze, hair part/temples, moustache, suit-and-tie structure, frame, opaque backing and exactly the two upper note-mark groups. Evidence limit under visible-source-differences-v1: the exact source is only65x67 pixels, so tiny eye lines, individual moustache strands and the note characters cannot be read reliably; do not invent spectacles, extra facial hair, badges or legible writing from those pixels. Source alpha extrema are0..255; visible-alpha-v1 preserves the real exterior transparent contour and opaque photographic/card content rather than deleting its dark areas.
